description: Source file defining UI components and formatting logic for node menu entries in a macOS app, including formatting node information, icons, and views using SwiftUI.

classes.name: NodeMenuEntryFormatter
classes.description: A utility struct providing static methods for formatting and displaying NodeInfo entries in the node menu interface.

classes.name: NodeMenuRowView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a single row in the node menu, displaying node icon, name, status, and other details.

classes.name: AndroidMark
classes.description: A SwiftUI view drawing a stylized Android icon for nodes identified as Android devices.

methods.name: isGateway
methods.description: Determines if a NodeInfo entry is a gateway based on its nodeId.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the NodeInfo entry is marked as connected.

methods.name: primaryName
methods.description: Returns the primary display name for a NodeInfo entry, defaulting to 'Gateway' if it is a gateway.

methods.name: summaryText
methods.description: Creates a summarized string describing the node, including IP, platform, version, and status.

methods.name: roleText
methods.description: Returns a string describing the node's role/status.

methods.name: detailLeft
methods.description: Provides detail string for the left side of the node row, including IP and role.

methods.name: headlineRight
methods.description: Returns the right-side headline text, usually platform info.

methods.name: detailRightVersion
methods.description: Returns the version information for display on the right side.

methods.name: platformText
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly platform string based on entry data.

methods.name: compactVersion
methods.description: Simplifies version string by removing extraneous parts.

methods.name: shortVersionLabel
methods.description: Converts a version string into a short label, prefixing with 'v' when appropriate.

methods.name: versionLabels
methods.description: Generates version labels for core and UI versions, optionally compacted.

methods.name: resolveVersions
methods.description: Determines core and UI version strings, falling back to legacy version if needed.

methods.name: isHeadlessPlatform
methods.description: Checks if the platform is a headless environment like Darwin, Linux, or Windows.

methods.name: leadingSymbol
methods.description: Provides a symbol name representing the node icon based on node type.

methods.name: isAndroid
methods.description: Determines if the node is an Android device based on device family or platform.

methods.name: safeSystemSymbol
methods.description: Checks for the availability of a system symbol; returns fallback if unavailable.
